headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Total consolidated GAAP revenue across Subscription and Professional Services.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Consolidated GAAP Revenue ($M): Elastic generated $478.1M in Q1 FY27 (+15.1% YoY vs $415.3M in Q1 FY26; $423.5M in Q2 FY26). Management guided Q2 FY27 to $486.0M–$487.0M; Street consensus sits at $486.77M, while buy-side whisper targets $494.0M+ on Search AI and cRPO conversion.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Subscription revenue excluding Monthly Elastic Cloud self-serve consumption.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Sales-Led Subscription Revenue ($M): Management's core enterprise KPI reached $399.0M in Q1 FY27 (+18% YoY vs $339.0M in Q1 FY26; $349.0M in Q2 FY26). Q2 FY27 guidance midpoint is $408.0M ($407.5M–$408.5M); whisper bogey requires $414.0M+ to confirm H2 acceleration.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Adjusted diluted EPS excluding stock-based compensation, amortization, and restructuring charges.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Non-GAAP Diluted EPS ($/sh): Q1 FY27 printed $0.70 (+19.85% beat vs $0.58 estimate). Management guided Q2 FY27 to $0.80–$0.82 (consensus $0.81), while buy-side whisper models $0.88+ given 100% 4Q beat rate (+13.08% avg surprise) and 19.0% guided non-GAAP operating margin.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Contracted remaining performance obligations expected to be recognized over the next 12 months.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Current RPO ($B): cRPO hit $1.153B in Q1 FY27 (+21% YoY reported, +20% CC) vs $971M in Q2 FY26. Street looks for ~$1.19B (+22.5% YoY) in Q2 FY27, while bulls require $1.21B+ (+24% YoY) to validate enterprise multi-year Search AI commitments.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Total enterprise customer accounts generating more than $100,000 in Annual Contract Value.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: >$100K ACV Customers: Reached 1,800+ in Q1 FY27 (record QoQ net additions of ~80+ from >1,720 in Q4 FY26; >1,600 in Q2 FY26). Consensus models 1,850+ in Q2 FY27; whisper targets 1,870+ fueled by >37% of high-ACV accounts adopting Elastic for GenAI/RAG workloads.
